faq.q: What is the current exchange rate of the Indian Rupee against the US Dollar?
faq.a: As of November 17, 2026, the Indian Rupee appreciated to ₹93.63 against the US dollar in early trade.

faq.q: Why are crude oil prices falling?
faq.a: Recent reports indicate that Brent crude oil prices have been falling due to growing fears of a global supply surplus and signs of weakening Chinese demand.
Foreign Fund Inflows refer to money invested by foreign individuals or institutions (Foreign Portfolio Investors or FPIs) into a country's financial markets, like stocks and bonds.

faq.q: How does a stronger rupee affect remittances from abroad?
faq.a: If you receive money from relatives working abroad, a stronger rupee means that when they convert their foreign currency (like USD) to INR, you will receive fewer rupees for the same amount of foreign currency.

faq.q: Will the rupee continue to strengthen?
faq.a: Currency movements are influenced by many factors and can be unpredictable. While current trends are positive due to falling crude and FII inflows, geopolitical events, global economic conditions, and the RBI's policies can all affect its future direction.
